pairs.subject: readiness-passports
pairs.evidence: src/features/teams/sub_factory/passport/improve/goldenStandard.ts:131 The passport improvement engine computes a single blended percentage across both automation and production readiness dimensions, creating a headline score that conceals the separate questions the two independent axes are meant to answer.

techniques.evidence: src/features/teams/sub_factory/passport/improve/improvePlan.ts:93 The improve plan flattens individual project gaps into an array instead of inverting into blocker rollups keyed by stable identifier and sorted by projects unlocked.

src/features/teams/sub_factory/passport/improve/StandardsScan.tsx:94 Findings only offer automated remediation without an allow-listed decision-memory overlay to record accepted trade-offs with reason, author, and date.

src/features/teams/sub_factory/passport/improve/provenance.ts:8 Provenance is limited to explanatory text for individual dimensions rather than stamping the passport with an immutable commit SHA and ladder versions.

src/features/teams/sub_factory/passport/improve/deployActions.ts:27 Concrete tooling and language names are retained for prompt grounding while all gating and applicability checks remain capability-shaped.
src/features/teams/sub_factory/passport/improve/goldenStandard.ts:131 Combines dimensions across both automation and production readiness into a single weighted golden percentage headline score.

declined.subject: readiness-passports
declined.reason: The Project Manager surface manages dev project CRUD, repository links, team graphs, and pipeline stages; it does not compute, display, or store readiness passports or portfolio readiness assessments.
